# nada

> LAION CLAP, the unfused HTSAT and RoBERTa model, on Modular MAX

LAION [CLAP](https://github.com/LAION-AI/CLAP) on [Modular MAX](https://docs.modular.com/max/). This is the unfused model: an HTSAT-tiny audio tower and a RoBERTa text tower, projected into one embedding. The weights are the Hugging Face release `laion/clap-htsat-unfused`, which is the `630k-audioset-best` checkpoint. Feature fusion, the four-crop path for long audio, is not in this graph.

The layout follows `solid_lens`. `config` is the architecture, `weights` binds a checkpoint, and `compile_model` traces the module for one text length and the 10-second mel shape. The graph is a MAX module (`max.experimental.nn`): the same `forward` runs eagerly or compiled.

## Modules

- [nada.audio](https://alix559.github.io/nada/audio.html.md): HTSAT audio tower, as the unfused `ClapAudioModel` runs it.
- [nada.config](https://alix559.github.io/nada/config.html.md): Shapes for the unfused LAION CLAP checkpoint.
- [nada.download](https://alix559.github.io/nada/download.html.md): Download `laion/clap-htsat-unfused` and write a numpy checkpoint.
- [nada.features](https://alix559.github.io/nada/features.html.md): Log-mel frontend for the unfused CLAP checkpoint.
- [nada.model](https://alix559.github.io/nada/model.html.md): Joint CLAP embedding.
- [nada.parity](https://alix559.github.io/nada/parity.html.md): Compare the MAX graph with Hugging Face on a tiny CLAP of the same weights.
- [nada.text](https://alix559.github.io/nada/text.html.md): RoBERTa text tower, as `ClapTextModel` runs it at inference.
- [nada.weights](https://alix559.github.io/nada/weights.html.md): Load a CLAP state dict onto the MAX module.
